subject: Clearview demo scheduling - exec calendar conflict
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Priya Raman <priya@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Beckett <t.beckett@clearviewhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clearview demo - initial scheduling

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking time to speak yesterday. Per our conversation, we'd like to get a 45-minute demo scheduled with your team to walk through the Dedicated offering and zero-trust deployment options for Clearview. Suggested slots next week:

- Tue 3/22 10:00–10:45 PT
- Tue 3/22 14:00–14:45 PT
- Wed 3/23 09:00–09:45 PT

I've attached a short deck that highlights the integration pattern we discussed. Marissa (AE) and Karthik (SE) will be joining. If one of these times works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Looking forward —
Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Senior AE, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_demo-deck.pdf
From: Dr. Priya Raman <priya@clearviewhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Beckett <t.beckett@clearviewhealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clearview demo - initial scheduling

Hi Rafael —

Appreciate the options. Execs (myself and our CTO) are traveling Tue morning unexpectedly for a board visit; the 10am PT slot won't work. Tom and I can do Tue 2pm PT, but our CTO can only join if it’s moved to Wed morning.

Would it be possible to run the demo at 2pm Tue without the CTO and then do a short follow-up on Wed with him? Or alternatively move to Wed 9am so we have the full team? We prefer to minimize duplicate sessions if possible.

Thanks —
Priya
Dr. Priya Raman | Head of Data & Analytics, Clearview Health
priya@clearviewhealth.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Priya Raman <priya@clearviewhealth.com>, Tom Beckett <t.beckett@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-18T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clearview demo - initial scheduling

Thanks for the heads up, Priya.

Marissa / Karthik — heads up: Clearview’s CTO may only be available Wed morning. Priya can do Tue 2pm without the CTO but prefers a single session if we can. Can we briefly triage options?

Options I see:
1) Keep Tue 2pm PT (Tom + Priya + AE/SE) and record the session; then do a 20–30m follow-up Wed with the CTO for any architecture-specific Qs.
2) Move the main demo to Wed 9am PT so CTO can attend; that may mean one of us swaps a meeting.
3) Run Tue 2pm as a condensed 30-minute exec-focused briefing (cover business + high-level architecture) and schedule a separate technical deep-dive later.

Karthik — if we move to Wed 9am, does that break any planned travel for you? I know you had a Bay Area customer visit that day in the afternoon, but should be fine unless there’s travel in the morning.

I’ve attached the deck again and a draft calendar invite for the Tue 2pm slot to make it easy to confirm.

— Rafael

Attachments: redwood_demo-deck.pdf, calendar-invite-20280322.ics
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Priya Raman <priya@clearviewhealth.com>, Tom Beckett <t.beckett@clearviewhealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clearview demo - initial scheduling

On Sun, Mar 18, 2028 at 10:22 AM Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com> wrote:
> Karthik — if we move to Wed 9am, does that break any planned travel for you?

I can do Wed 9am PT — no morning travel on my calendar. I do have a client workshop Wed afternoon (SF), so Wed morning is fine. If the CTO wants a slightly more technical session, I can expand the architecture section to include the deployment topology and KV-cache behavior for the Dedicated flow (15–20 minutes).

If it helps reduce duplication, happy to run Wed 9am as the primary session and include a short run-through for Priya/Tom on Tue 2pm focused on business value only (15–20 minutes).

+1 on recording either session.

— Karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Priya Raman <priya@clearviewhealth.com>, Tom Beckett <t.beckett@clearviewhealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-18T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clearview demo - initial scheduling

Hi all — quick update from me. Given Priya’s preference to avoid duplicate full demos and the CTO’s limited window, let’s move the main demo to Wed 3/23 09:00–09:45 PT (confirmed). Rafael, I sent the updated calendar invite and included the recording permission. Karthik will cover the technical deep-dive in the second half and we’ll keep the first 20 minutes focused on use cases and timelines for a Dedicated pilot.

Priya — if anything changes on your side and the CTO becomes available Tue 2pm, we can keep the shorter Tue slot as a backup. Otherwise we’ll see you Wed morning.

Thanks everyone —
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
